name: InlineMessage
purpose: Short, tone-colored inline status line with optional click-revealed detail.
intent: Give a short status message a place to reveal supplemental detail without a full banner or dialog, built on the Popup primitive.

figmaSource.note: 12 raw Figma variants (tone x isOpen) but only 2 real states per tone - most of the outer isOpen variant values are garbage auto-generated strings (isOpen3..isOpen12), not real booleans, except for the info tone. The reliable signal is the nested `popup` instance's own isOpen component property.

subComponents.name: inline-message-trigger
subComponents.note: The row itself - icon, titleText, secondaryText - nested inside the inline-message component's own `popup` instance as its trigger slot.

useCases: Any short inline status line that sometimes needs more explanation
antiPatterns: Content essential to completing a task with no fallback if the panel is never opened

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Tone-mapped status icon (24px container, matching Icon's spacing="spacious"). tone="default" falls back to a plain CSS dot - no matching status icon exists in the generated set.

anatomy.name: secondaryText
anatomy.description: Optional muted trailing text (body-md typography), rendered only when provided.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Rendered through Popup (default styled skin, alignment=bottomLeft) when provided - Popup owns positioning/portal/dismissal.

secondaryText.description: Optional muted trailing text, shown only when provided - no separate show/hide toggle.

tone.description: Selects the status icon, icon color, and the tint shown on hover/open.

content.description: Detail revealed in a popup when clicked. Omitting it renders a plain, non-interactive row with no button and no popup.

open.description: Controlled open state for the detail popup.

defaultOpen.description: Initial open state for uncontrolled usage.

onOpenChange.description: Called with the next open value whenever the row is clicked.

className.description: Composes with the root row's class list.

data-force-state.description: Documentation-only: mirrors :hover/:focus-visible as a static Storybook regression reference, the same convention Button/Checkbox/Switch use. Not part of the public API.

slots.name: content
supports: short supplemental detail text or elements, rendered inside Popup's default panel

default.icon: plain CSS dot (no matching status icon exists)

semantic.rowPadding: --spacing-none (the row itself carries no padding - see textGroupPadding)
semantic.textGroupPadding: --spacing-xs on both sides - covers the icon-to-title gap and the row's own trailing space

tokens.note: Tone-specific icon color and hover/open tint tokens are documented per tone in the `variants.tone` block above, not duplicated here.

accessibility.focusable: only when content is provided (renders a real button)
accessibility.focusIndicator: Shared Focus Ring primitive (focusRingClassNames.focusRing + focusRingDefault) on the trigger button; :focus-visible shows the same tint as :hover rather than a separate treatment

behaviorRules: Renders a plain, non-interactive div (no button, no aria-expanded, no Popup mounted) when content is absent.
Renders a real <button type="button"> when content is provided; clicking toggles the popup.
Does not open on hover or focus - click/keyboard-activation only, per Popup's own guidance that hover-only reveals are Tooltip's job.
Supports controlled (open/onOpenChange) and uncontrolled (defaultOpen) usage - the standard React pattern, since there is no native form element to delegate this to.
Renders through Popup with its default styled skin (not unstyled) - the first component in the system to exercise that code path.
Requests alignment="bottomLeft", matching Figma's own popup instance property on every variant.
Sets closeOnEscape={false} and closeOnOutsideClick={false} on Popup - the detail persists until the row is clicked again, per Popup's own documented prediction for this component.
Leaves manageTriggerAria at Popup's default (true) - aria-expanded/aria-controls is the correct pattern for a click-to-reveal disclosure.
Styles the hover/open tint off Popup's own aria-expanded attribute rather than a redundant custom data-open attribute.

Applies the shared Focus Ring primitive (focusRingClassNames.focusRing + focusRingDefault) to the trigger button, and groups :focus-visible into the same tint rule as :hover - the same convention Button/IconButton/ToggleButton use - rather than a one-off local focus style.

The row itself (.root) carries no padding - a native <button> otherwise inherits the UA stylesheet's own default button padding (1px block / 6px inline in Chrome), so .root resets padding to --spacing-none explicitly and the text group (.text) carries the real --spacing-xs padding on both sides instead.
compositionRules: Built on top of Popup - do not reimplement positioning, the portal, or Escape/outside-click handling locally.
Use Tooltip instead for a hover-only, non-interactive supplemental hint.
contentRules: Keep title and secondaryText short enough for one line - neither has built-in truncation.
content wraps inside Popup's own default panel width.
themeRules: Uses semantic tokens only - works in light and dark themes.
implementationNotes: Use React.memo for the exported component.
No hardcoded colors, spacing, or typography.
Required extending the shared Icon primitive with a 'discovery' IconColor value/class - a real, pre-existing gap confirmed absent before this component needed it, not invented locally.
do: Omit content for a message that has nothing more to say.
Use open/onOpenChange to reveal detail programmatically after an action completes.
dont: Do not wrap trivial content in a popup just to add an expand affordance nobody needs.
Do not reach for this component as a hover-only hint - use Tooltip.
Do not fabricate a status icon for tone="default" - use the plain dot.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders a real status icon for a non-default tone; renders a plain dot for tone="default".
Renders a plain row (no button) when content is omitted.
Renders a real button, with aria-expanded, when content is provided.
Applies the shared Focus Ring primitive to the trigger button; :focus-visible shows the same tint as :hover.
Toggles the popup open/closed on click (uncontrolled).
Does not close on Escape or an outside click.
Supports className on the root row.
Maps every tone to its own overlay/hovered tint token.
Delegates positioning/portal/dismissal to Popup rather than a local implementation.
Storybook includes Playground, Variants, Content, and EdgeCases.
Tests cover title/secondaryText rendering, tone icons, open/close toggling, controlled/uncontrolled usage, dismissal behavior, and className.
knownLimitations: No disabled prop - not evidenced in Figma's own component set.
futureEnhancements: A disabled prop if a real product need for it emerges.
